name: Bookins
shortDescription: Set availability, share a secure booking link, and manage appointments from one workspace.
description: Bookins helps African service businesses configure services, set weekly availability, share secure public booking links, manage appointments, organise a small team, and keep client history together. You open prefilled WhatsApp, SMS or email messages yourself; Bookins does not send them. Guest access is limited to release-pinned booking actions and never exposes the owner workspace.
releaseNotes: Adds customizable booking-page themes and default calendar layouts, with a fuller desktop layout and square date cells. Fixes campaign draft navigation, false schedule-change warnings, keyboard focus, legacy booking-link Calendar messaging, and offline data recovery.

seo.title: Bookins
seo.description: Set availability, share a secure booking link, and manage appointments from one workspace.

capabilities.description: Creates an account-scoped Table for the public booking identity and link metadata.
Creates an account-scoped Table for weekly schedules, timezone, notice, and booking horizon.
Creates an account-scoped Table for active public and private service definitions.
Creates an account-scoped Table for bookings, owner time off, and unique slot reservations.
Creates an optional account-scoped Table for contact notes and tags.
Creates an optional account-scoped Table for team members, their colours, and which schedule and services each one has.
Creates an optional account-scoped Table for saved campaigns: audience filters, message wording and offer text. Bookins never sends campaigns.
Allows an expiring booking link to read its public page, list openings, and create one conflict-safe booking.
Lets the installed owner manage booking lifecycle actions from the selected Goalmatic account.
Connects your Google Calendar, reads events to flag clashes, adds or updates a booking's event only when you ask, and lets the public booking link read busy times (no event details).

Installs one scheduled workflow (off until you turn it on) that emails the account owner today's appointments, new bookings and tomorrow's prefilled reminder links each morning. Guests are not emailed.

tables.name: Booking Profiles
tables.description: Public booking identity and link metadata for the installed account.

tables.name: Booking Schedules
tables.description: Recurring weekly availability for one bookable resource.

tables.name: Booking Services
tables.description: Bookable services and their schedule, visibility, duration, and display price.

tables.name: Bookings
tables.description: Confirmed, completed, no-show, and cancelled bookings plus owner time off, each with a unique schedule-slot reservation.

tables.name: Booking Contacts
tables.description: Owner-maintained contact notes and tags, keyed by email. Optional; contacts are otherwise derived from bookings.

tables.name: Team Members
tables.description: Team members, each with their own schedule and the services they offer. The owner is implicit and needs no row. Optional.

tables.name: Campaigns
tables.description: Saved campaigns: audience filters, message wording and offer text. Bookins prepares messages; you open them in your own apps. Optional.

workflows.name: Bookins - daily agenda email
workflows.description: Every morning, reads Bookings, Profiles and Services and emails the account owner today's appointments, today's time off, bookings received in the last 24 hours, and prefilled reminder links for tomorrow's appointments. Guests are not emailed; the owner opens each link.
